source-chat.和王磊约试用，也约一碗面: Trying the Workbench and meeting for noodles
source-chat.万叶和王磊是浙江大学软件工程同学，2016 年入学时住同一层宿舍。王磊现在在杭州:
Caspian and Wang Lei studied software engineering together at Zhejiang University. They lived on the same dormitory floor when they enrolled in 2016. Wang Lei now works on backend development at Alibaba Cloud in Hangzhou.
Caspian: I want to get the Kimi Workbench pilot working this week. I am keeping 9 to 11 a.m. free of meetings and setting aside half an hour in the afternoon to review feedback.
Wang Lei: Send me a working version and I will try it on Wednesday evening. Skip the feature tour for now; I will use it for a task of my own.
Caspian: Sounds good. When I am back in Hangzhou for the National Day holiday, shall we have pian er chuan noodles near campus again?
Wang Lei: Sure. Let me know once you have a date.

demo-v2-source-chat-lu.和刘老师聊工作，也聊读书: Talking with Professor Liu about work and books
demo-v2-source-chat-lu.万叶：刘老师，最近在 Kimi 做一个工作台，从访谈到前端都要自己跟。\n刘建国:
Caspian: Professor Liu, I have been building a Workbench at Kimi lately, following everything from interviews to the frontend myself.
Liu Jianguo: It sounds like a larger version of your graduation project. Which part is hardest?
Caspian: Listing features is easy. Figuring out which ones are worth doing first is harder.
Liu Jianguo: Watch how one person completes something from beginning to end. Do not rush to summarize ten different needs.
Caspian: In five interviews, three people got stuck after a task was interrupted.
Liu Jianguo: Then study that step closely first. Once you have improved it, ask them to try it again.
Caspian: Is that why you had me ask classmates in the dining hall how they signed up for events back then?
Liu Jianguo: Exactly. And try reading something beyond product articles. Have you read any other books lately?
Caspian: I am reading Zhi Shen Shi Nei. I will take it back to Hangzhou during the National Day holiday and keep reading.
Liu Jianguo: Good. Come by for tea if you have time when you are back. No presentation needed.

demo-v2-source-chat-song.约国庆后在上海见面: Planning a visit to Shanghai after the holiday
demo-v2-source-chat-song.万叶：国庆你回杭州吗？\n李娜：今年留上海，想把家里收拾一下。你呢？\n万叶：先:
Caspian: Are you going back to Hangzhou for the National Day holiday?
Li Na: I am staying in Shanghai this year. I want to get the apartment in order. What about you?
Caspian: I will visit my parents first. I might come to Shanghai in mid-October.
Li Na: Then come and have a meal with me. Do not just change trains at Hongqiao.
Caspian: I will. Have you been working on AI features too?
Li Na: We are trying some, but I am more interested in what users are missing just before they leave the page.
Caspian: We have also moved additional tool integrations further down the list. First, we want people to be able to resume a task after it stops.
Li Na: That sounds concrete. Bring your laptop when you visit; a ten-minute look will be enough.
Caspian: And no work talk for the rest of the visit. I would like to walk along Suzhou Creek.
Li Na: Sounds good. Let me know when your dates are set.

demo-v2-source-chat-he.万叶：何志强，首轮评测我想先跑五类任务，不做一个大分数。\n何志强：可以，每类写:
Caspian: He Zhiqiang, for the first evaluation, I would like to try five types of tasks without combining everything into one big score.
He Zhiqiang: That works. Define what counts as complete for each type.
Caspian: Let us start with organizing materials and revising existing drafts. Both came up in the interviews.
He Zhiqiang: Keep the failure cases, especially the context from before each tool call.
Caspian: Let us keep model calls within CNY 2,000 for this round.
He Zhiqiang: I will run a small batch first and send you the actual usage and a breakdown of failures.
Caspian: The interface will show the last completed step. A tool failure will not appear as completion.
He Zhiqiang: Good. We should distinguish a mistaken model judgment from a tool that did not respond.
Caspian: Shall we review the first round together on Thursday afternoon?
He Zhiqiang: Four o’clock works. Bring ten complete records to start with.

demo-v2-source-chat-xu.把中断发生的时刻测清楚: Testing the exact moment a task is interrupted
demo-v2-source-chat-xu.万叶：我把中断和继续接好了，你今天能帮我看吗？\n徐静：可以，我会在保存前后各按:
Caspian: I have connected interruption and resume. Can you take a look today?
Xu Jing: Yes. I will interrupt once before saving and once after, as well as testing normal completion.
Caspian: Partially written files will remain, with the interface marking them for review.
Xu Jing: If I close the application and reopen it, can it recover the previous state?
Caspian: It can read the last execution event. I will add another restart check.
Xu Jing: There is another case: the user stops, edits the file, and then resumes.
Caspian: It must preserve those edits. I will make it report a version conflict.
Xu Jing: I will test that. The error should tell me which file is affected, rather than just saying it failed.
Caspian: Agreed. After testing, let us fix anything that loses user input first.
Xu Jing: I will send you the reproduction notes before noon tomorrow.

demo-v2-source-chat-tang.午休时一起走了一遍确认弹窗: Walking through a confirmation dialog over lunch
demo-v2-source-chat-tang.万叶：下楼买咖啡吗？我顺便给你看一下确认弹窗。\n唐丽：走。现在弹窗只有是否继续:
Caspian: Want to go downstairs for coffee? I can show you the confirmation dialog on the way.
Tang Li: Let us go. Right now it only asks whether to continue. I cannot tell what I am confirming.
Caspian: When sending an email, the recipient and full message should be visible.
Tang Li: Yes, and it should ask again if the message is edited. Reading a document does not need a confirmation at every step.
Caspian: I will change the button to “Send this email.”
Tang Li: Rejecting it should let the user return and edit the content, without showing an error.
Caspian: I will connect this version to a working page this afternoon.
Tang Li: Send me something I can actually click through, not just a screenshot.
Caspian: Will do. Iced Americano as usual?
Tang Li: Hot today. It is a little chilly outside.

demo-v2-source-chat-shen.对齐任务状态与文件版本: Aligning task states and file versions
demo-v2-source-chat-shen.万叶：前端现在要区分等用户、运行中和失败。\n沈杰：我给你明确状态字段，不用从消:
Caspian: The frontend needs to distinguish waiting for the user, running, and failed.
Shen Jie: I will give you explicit state fields so you do not have to infer them from message text.
Caspian: If the page closes, the task continues as long as the local service stays running, right?
Shen Jie: Right. If the service stops, it leaves an interrupted state. Restarting will not pretend it completed.
Caspian: Does every file save include a version number?
Shen Jie: Yes. A version mismatch returns a conflict, and the old content remains.
Caspian: Then the editor can ask users to review their own changes first.
Shen Jie: That works. I will also return the last completed step.
Caspian: That gives the resume button something clear to work from.
Shen Jie: The API notes are updated. Let us connect it all and walk through it this afternoon.

demo-v2-source-chat-zhao.和高中班主任说说近况: Catching up with a high school teacher
demo-v2-source-chat-zhao.万叶：赵老师，好久没联系，最近忙吗？\n赵建军：刚送走一届高三，难得轻松一点。你:
Caspian: Teacher Zhao, it has been a while. Have you been busy?
Zhao Jianjun: My latest class has just finished its final year of high school, so things are a little quieter. Have you settled into Beijing?
Caspian: I have. I work on Kimi at Moonshot AI now, and the work is interesting.
Zhao Jianjun: I have used Kimi too. So that is what you do. Are you busy every day?
Caspian: We have a pilot coming up, so the days are busy. I go running on weekends.
Zhao Jianjun: That is good. You used to sit still for ages once you started working on math problems.
Caspian: I am still trying to change that habit. I will be back in Hangzhou during the National Day holiday and would love to have tea with you.
Zhao Jianjun: Spend time with your family first. Come if you have time to spare. There is no rush.
Caspian: Of course. I will message you ahead of time.
Zhao Jianjun: Safe travels. We can arrange it once you are back.

demo-v2-source-chat-wu.敲定第一批内测回访的安排: Arranging the first pilot follow-up sessions
demo-v2-source-chat-wu.万叶：十月十二日那轮先按八位用户准备吧。\n吴婷：可以，五位已经聊过，另外三位我:
Caspian: Let us prepare for eight users in the October 12 pilot.
Wu Ting: Sounds good. We have spoken to five; I am still arranging times with the other three.
Caspian: We should ask them to bring their own tasks instead of following a script we give them.
Wu Ting: I will ask them in the invitation to bring something they have recently wanted to get done.
Caspian: If they get stuck, recording where is enough. They do not need to make excuses for us.
Wu Ting: Ha, I will phrase that a little more naturally.
Caspian: I will cut the usage guide down to one page.
Wu Ting: Good. I will put the feedback link at the end. We should avoid sending a huge bundle of documents.
Caspian: Let Han Xiaomei review the invitation today, then we can check the participant list again tomorrow.
Wu Ting: Got it. I will add replies to the spreadsheet as they arrive.

demo-v2-source-chat-ye.一起把成果编辑区做顺: Making the output editor easier to use
demo-v2-source-chat-ye.万叶：今天你接状态列表，我做成果编辑，可以吗？\n叶涛：行。切换文稿前记得留住草:
Caspian: Can you take the status list today while I work on editing outputs?
Ye Tao: Sure. Remember to keep the draft when switching documents.
Caspian: I have added automatic local draft saving. Saving an official version still requires the Save button.
Ye Tao: Long chats should not keep jumping to the bottom. Yesterday, it kept pulling me away from an earlier message.
Caspian: Got it. For narrow windows, I have made the output area a collapsible side panel.
Ye Tao: Check that focus returns to the button that opened it when the panel closes.
Caspian: What do you want for lunch? I would like to get out for a walk.
Ye Tao: The noodle place downstairs? When we get back, let us test again with realistic long titles.
Caspian: Sounds good. We will check both Chinese and English.
Ye Tao: See you at two. Lunch first.

demo-v2-source-chat-liang.五次访谈里重复出现的停顿: The same hesitation across five interviews
demo-v2-source-chat-liang.梁佳：五次访谈原话都在文档里了。\n万叶：我先看具体操作，再写结论。哪一段最值得:
Liang Jia: The verbatim notes from all five interviews are in the document.
Caspian: I will look at the specific interactions before drawing conclusions. Which part is most useful to replay?
Liang Jia: After a task stopped, three people asked, “How far has it got?”
Caspian: Then we can test execution status and the resume entry point in the same prototype round.
Liang Jia: One person also wanted to change the request before deciding which part to run again.
Caspian: That is key. They need more than a retry.
Liang Jia: Exactly. Some people also do not want to provide all their materials. They should be able to choose just a few.
Caspian: I will keep that choice in the interface so they do not have to import everything first.
Liang Jia: Let us follow up with two people in the next round and see whether the changes make it clearer.
Caspian: Let me know when the time is set. I will join and listen.

demo-v2-source-chat-wei.周日四点，奥森见: Sunday at four, Olympic Forest Park
demo-v2-source-chat-wei.万叶：周日还跑吗？这周坐太久了。\n魏鹏：跑，四点奥森南门？\n万叶：可以，先按:
Caspian: Are we running on Sunday? I have spent too much of this week sitting.
Wei Peng: Yes. South gate of Olympic Forest Park at four?
Caspian: Works for me. Let us aim for six kilometers and walk if we need to.
Wei Peng: It is hardly a training camp. Just do not answer work messages while running.
Caspian: I will keep my phone in the running belt and wrap up work on Friday.
Wei Peng: Noodles afterward? The soup at the place we tried last time was good.
Caspian: Yes. It has been cooler in the mornings and evenings. Should we bring light jackets?
Wei Peng: Bring one. It gets cold once we stop.
Caspian: If it rains, we can switch to a walk. Let us check the weather on the day.
Wei Peng: No problem. We will be in touch before leaving.

demo-v2-source-chat-du.国庆回杭州，先吃一顿家常饭: A family meal in Hangzhou during the holiday
demo-v2-source-chat-du.万叶：妈，我想二号中午回杭州吃饭，车次还没定。\n杜秀英：好，你定了再告诉我，不:
Caspian: Mum, I am thinking of coming back to Hangzhou for lunch on the second. I have not chosen a train yet.
Du Xiuying: Good. Let me know when you have. No need to rush off early in the morning.
Caspian: I will not fill this visit with work. We can take a walk together in the afternoon.
Du Xiuying: That would be lovely. The osmanthus on the balcony has started blooming. You will be able to smell it when you come home.
Caspian: I would like Dad’s pian er chuan noodles.
Du Xiuying: I have told him. He is already thinking about which ingredients to buy.
Caspian: No need to make too much. Enough for the three or four of us is fine.
Du Xiuying: Your sister will be home too. She says she has new songs for you to hear.
Caspian: Great. We can look at her coursework later.
Du Xiuying: Eat first when you get home. Do not turn the house into an office too.

demo-v2-source-chat-lin.和父亲约一碗片儿川: A bowl of noodles with Dad
demo-v2-source-chat-lin.万叶：爸，二号如果中午到，想吃你做的片儿川。\n万建明：可以，提前一天告诉我，我:
Caspian: Dad, if I arrive around noon on the second, I would love your pian er chuan noodles.
Wan Jianming: Of course. Tell me the day before and I will buy preserved mustard greens and bamboo shoots.
Caspian: Just noodles will be fine. No need for a table full of dishes.
Wan Jianming: All right. What does that Workbench you are building help people do?
Caspian: It turns a request into a process that gets things done, and lets you see how far it has got.
Wan Jianming: Can people still make changes if it gets something wrong?
Caspian: Yes. Lately I have been working on stopping, changing the request, and carrying on.
Wan Jianming: That sounds useful. People change their minds when they are working too.
Caspian: I will show you a simple example when I am home.
Wan Jianming: Let us eat first. We can look afterward if we feel like it.

demo-v2-source-chat-jiang.和妹妹看校园活动报名原型: Reviewing a campus registration prototype with his sister
demo-v2-source-chat-jiang.万婷婷：哥，我们课程要做校园活动报名，页面越想越多。\n万叶：先说一个同学从看见:
Wan Tingting: We have to build campus event registration for a class, and I keep thinking of more pages to add.
Caspian: Start with one student. What steps do they take from seeing an event to signing up?
Wan Tingting: They check the time and place, fill in their information, and find out whether registration succeeded.
Caspian: Sketch those three steps first. The other pages can wait.
Wan Tingting: I also wanted to add a chatbot.
Caspian: First ask classmates what specific questions they have when signing up.
Wan Tingting: Right. If they only need to know the location, we can make it clear on the page.
Caspian: Exactly. Ask two people to try it first, and you will see what needs explaining.
Wan Tingting: I will send you the prototype this weekend, along with some new songs.
Caspian: You can send the songs now. We will look at the coursework over the weekend.

demo-v2-source-chat-zhou.处理出租屋漏水和续租: A leaking kitchen sink and a lease renewal
demo-v2-source-chat-zhou.万叶：厨房水槽下面又湿了，周末做饭才发现。\n周琳：先看看是不是软管接口，拍张照:
Caspian: It is wet under the kitchen sink again. I only noticed while cooking over the weekend.
Zhou Lin: Check whether it is the hose connection and send the landlord a photo.
Caspian: I did. He said we can arrange a repair, so I am planning to wait at home on Saturday morning.
Zhou Lin: Then leave it assembled for now. Your lease is nearly up for renewal too, is it not?
Caspian: At the end of November. I want to discuss renewing after the leak is fixed.
Zhou Lin: Makes sense. Get the repair responsibilities and any rent increase written down clearly.
Caspian: How was the moving company you used last time?
Zhou Lin: It was fine, but there is no need to rush into moving. A short commute matters.
Caspian: True. Come over for dinner once it is fixed. I have learned to pan-fry salmon.
Zhou Lin: Looking forward to it. Do not just send me a photo of the finished dish.

demo-v2-source-chat-gao.万叶：青岛那批照片你选完了吗？我还有三百多张没看。\n高远：先选十二张，别一开始:
Caspian: Have you finished choosing your Qingdao photos? I still have more than three hundred to look through.
Gao Yuan: Choose twelve first. Do not start editing straight away.
Caspian: My favorite is the one by the sea on the cloudy day. The colors are very soft.
Gao Yuan: I like your reflection in the train window. It is more interesting than a standard tourist shot.
Caspian: Next time I want to plan fewer stops and just walk along the streets.
Gao Yuan: Agreed. A trip does not have to cover every point on the map.
Caspian: I will put together a small version of the album this weekend.
Gao Yuan: Send it to me. I can help with the order.
Caspian: When it is printed, I will bring it for you to see after a run.
Gao Yuan: Good. Keep the cover simple and use the photograph you like best.
